jobs.title: Senior Manager Hardware Engineering
jobs.description_text: About Acron Aviation (Avionics – Surveillance): Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Within Avionics, the Surveillance product line develops and sustains systems that enable aircraft awareness, collision avoidance, and airspace interoperability. Our portfolio includes TCAS, Mode S transponders, ADS-B, and integrated surveillance solutions deployed across commercial, military, and rotorcraft platforms. This work is performed in highly regulated environments and demands deep expertise across systems, hardware, software, and RF throughout the full product lifecycle. The Opportunity As the aerospace industry enters into the new era of Urban Air Mobility (UAM), Acron Aviation will be at the forefront of this new market. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence engineering strategy, develop future leaders, and drive organizational excellence across multiple hardware disciplines in a highly collaborative environment, developing TCAS/ACAS and transponder radios for jet, rotorcraft, and UAM platforms. As Hardware Engineering Manager for our Surveillance product line, you will lead and inspire a diverse organization of RF, FPGA/Firmware, Electrical, Mechanical, CAD, and Component Engineering professionals responsible for delivering mission-critical avionics hardware — from concept through certification, production, and lifelong product support. jobs.description_text: Acron Aviation is seeking motivated and innovative Software Engineering interns to join our engineering teams in St. Petersburg, Florida. This full-time, onsite internship is anticipated to run May through August and provides an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge in a professional engineering environment. You will work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to the development, testing, integration, and support of software for aviation products and technologies. jobs.title: Sustaining Engineer Intern - Grand Rapids Site
jobs.description_text: Acron Aviation is seeking a Sustaining Engineer Intern to join our Recorders Engineering Team in Grand Rapids, Michigan. In this role, you will support the ongoing lifecycle management of existing products by assisting with updates to mechanical designs, drawings, and technical documentation. You will contribute to sustaining and improving released hardware, including structural components, housings, enclosures, and PCB/CCA documentation, while helping preserve critical engineering knowledge through design traceability and documentation improvements. This internship provides hands-on experience working alongside mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, and test engineering professionals supporting aerospace and aviation products.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer Intern - St. Pete Site
jobs.description_text: Acron Aviation is seeking motivated and innovative Systems Engineering Interns to join our engineering team in St. Petersburg, Florida. This full-time, onsite internship is anticipated to run May through August and provides an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge in a professional engineering environment. You will work alongside experienced systems engineers and contribute to projects supporting the development, integration, verification, certification, and sustainment of aerospace recorder products and related technologies. Depending on your assigned team and project, you may gain experience in systems development, requirements analysis, product design, system integration, verification and validation, environmental testing, problem investigation, and technical documentation. Intern assignments will be aligned with current business and program needs while providing exposure to real-world aerospace systems engineering practices and the development of safety-critical aviation products.
